description: This file defines Flutter widgets for displaying the order process progression in an e-commerce app. It includes the OrderProgress widget, which visually represents the status of an order via a sequence of dots and lines, indicating stages like Ordered, Processing, Packed, Shipped, Delivered, or Canceled. It also contains auxiliary widgets and an enum for different order statuses.

classes.name: OrderProgress
classes.description: A Flutter widget that visualizes the stages of an order process, showing progress through ordered, processing, packed, shipped, and delivered states, with optional cancellation indicator.

classes.name: ProcessDotWithLine
classes.description: A widget representing a stage in the order process, showing a title, status indicator, and connecting lines to adjacent stages.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the OrderProgress widget, arranging stage indicators horizontally.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the ProcessDotWithLine widget, representing a single stage with lines connecting to other stages.
